assumptions: Current COMP.FUNDA INDL/C/D/STD is the local proxy for the 2007 Annual Industrial and Research source vintage; source-specific product inclusion cannot be confirmed.

Beginning MVE uses prior-FYEAR CSHO×PRCC_F; prior annual HIID is matched to active PRIHISTUSA/PRIHISTCAN SEC_HISTORY ITEMVALUE, with same-HIID dated SECM P as fallback if primary history is absent and the row is not marked J. Unique company-month P is not required because the known historical issue can be the Canadian primary while another issue is also marked P.

Valid annual SICH controls industry classification. If it is missing or invalid, fallback requires an active CCMXPF_LINKTABLE row (USEDFLAG=1, LINKPRIM P/C, LINKTYPE LC/LU) and date-effective STOCKNAMES SICCD. Exact SIC conflicts remain unassigned; a shared exclusion decision is used only when all valid candidates agree on the paper's excluded ranges. Screen status is unresolved for mixed or unavailable candidates; unresolved records are reported and not dropped by a blanket CRSP-coverage gate. Current header SIC is not used.

Annual CSHO×PRCC_F remains the denominator. Price denomination follows same-issue daily CURCDD, then same-issue monthly CURCDM; there is no annual CURCD fallback. Monthly CURCDM is currency evidence only. Annual PRCC_F uses point-date EXRATD at the daily quote date when available, otherwise at annual DATADATE; daily/monthly/annual price-level comparisons and AJEX factor checks are diagnostics and do not replace the annual price.

Annual flow values use provider EXRAT12M conversion to USD; same-currency classifiers remain in native units, and mixed-currency classifiers use common-USD flow and point-date annual-price rates. Duplicate identical rates are collapsed; conflicting rates are unavailable.
Annual percentile cutoffs use SAS PCTLDEF=5 and strict outside-cutoff deletion; bins use lower-inclusive, upper-exclusive endpoints. The undefined Table 4 statistical-outlier deletion is not applied.
Conventional pooled OLS standard errors are used because the covariance method is not reported; no fixed effects or clustering are added.

limitations: The current merged North America COMP.FUNDA vintage is only a proxy for the paper's 2007 Annual Industrial and Research files; product-specific historical inclusion cannot be confirmed.

Some annual SICH values are missing or invalid. Valid SICH is preferred; only unique dated CRSP/CCM links fill missing or invalid codes. Exact-code conflicts, cross-exclusion-range conflicts, and records without valid dated SIC remain explicitly unclassified. Screen-unresolved records are retained and reported rather than removed by CRSP coverage.
The paper's Table 4 footnote 17 says statistical outliers are deleted but does not specify the deletion criterion; no substitute cutoff is invented.
The paper does not identify the estimator or covariance method; conventional pooled OLS inference is a transparent best-effort choice.
The source does not define percentile quantile convention or exact bin endpoints; PCTLDEF=5 with strict tail trimming and lower-inclusive/upper-exclusive bins are explicit conventions.

Historical beginning-price issue mapping relies on date-effective SEC_HISTORY primary-item values and a same-HIID dated SECM P fallback. SEC_HISTORY/SECM discrepancies, HIID joiner markers, and unresolved histories are excluded from supported denominator construction; company-wide P uniqueness is not imposed. Current header identifiers are not substituted for historical issue identifiers.

Annual PRCC_F is retained even when it differs from security daily/monthly prices. Dated daily/monthly currency codes and product/factor/date comparisons document observed price provenance; no daily/monthly price substitute is imposed. Monthly CURCDM denomination uses point-date EXRATD at annual DATADATE for annual PRCC_F; the paper does not specify cross-currency timing for scaled classifiers, so mixed-currency cases remain an explicit approximation.
